sections.heading: Culture and identity in Nigerian Peoples and Culture
paragraphs: Culture and identity is studied here as a specific part of Nigerian Peoples and Culture. Begin by defining the term precisely and identifying the problem it helps explain or solve. Keep the scope narrow: related ideas may interact with it, but they are not interchangeable.
